title: Chapter 7: The Interrupted Wedding and Bertha Mason
chineseTitle: 第 7 章：被中断的婚礼与阁楼疯女人

paragraphs.en: On a bright summer morning, Rochester and I walked to the quiet parish church for our wedding. But as the clergyman asked if anyone knew of any impediment to our union, a stranger named Mr. Briggs stepped forward, declaring: 'The marriage cannot go on! Mr. Rochester has a wife now living!'
paragraphs.zh: 在一个明亮的夏天早上，罗切斯特和我步入安静的教区教堂举行婚礼。但当牧师询问是否有人知道我们结合的任何阻碍时，一位名叫布里格斯先生的陌生人走上前去，宣布：“婚礼不能继续！罗切斯特先生有一位现活着的妻子！”

paragraphs.en: Rochester grew deathly pale, acknowledging the truth. He led the wedding party back to Thornfield and up to the locked third-floor chamber. Unlocking the door, he revealed a terrifying sight: a wild, monstrous woman with dark hair and a discolored face was pacing the room like a caged beast. It was Bertha Mason, Rochester's mad wife, whom he had been tricked into marrying fifteen years earlier in Jamaica, and who was guarded by Grace Poole.
paragraphs.zh: 罗切斯特面色如死般苍白，承认了真相。他带着婚礼随行人员回到桑菲尔德，上了锁着的三楼房间。打开门锁，他露出了一个可怕的景象：一个狂乱、怪诞的女人带着黑发和变色的面庞正像笼中野兽一样在房间里踱步。那是伯莎·梅森，罗切斯特疯狂的妻子（十五年前他在牙买加被诱骗娶了她），由格雷斯·普尔看守着。

paragraphs.en: Rochester begged me to stay with him as his true wife in spirit, offering to take me to his villa in the south of France. My heart bled for his tragic suffering, but my conscience and self-respect remained unyielding: 'I will keep the law given by God; sanctioned by man. Laws and principles are not for the times when there is no temptation. They are for such moments as this.' That night, while Rochester slept, I packed a small bundle and fled Thornfield into the dark night.
paragraphs.zh: 罗切斯特恳求我留在身边作为他灵魂上真正的新娘，提出带我去他在法国南部的别墅。我的心为他的悲剧痛苦而流血，但我的良知与自尊保持着不可动摇：“我要守住上帝给出的律法；由人类认可的律法。律法与原则不是为了没有诱惑的时刻。它们正是为了像现在这样的时刻。”那天晚上，当罗切斯特入睡时，我收拾了一个小包，在黑夜中逃离了桑菲尔德。
